root_cause.text: The set received ioctl performed metadata updates within a transaction before checking whether adding the received UUID item would overflow the UUID tree b-tree leaf, causing a transaction abort (and filesystem read-only) when the overflow occurred.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the overflow check before the transaction start: it adds an early call to `btrfs_uuid_tree_check_overflow()` in `_btrfs_ioctl_set_received_subvol` to return an error before any modifications, avoiding the need for a transaction abort. The commit message states: "Fix this by doing an early check for item overflow before starting a transaction."

The commit message states: "Fix this by doing an early check for item overflow before starting a transaction."

candidates.rationale: Updates the root item's received timestamp within the transaction before ensuring there is enough space in the UUID tree leaf for the new UUID item, which can lead to overflow on addition.
Similarly updates the timestamp without pre-checking space for the subsequent UUID addition, contributing to the overflow risk.
Begins the comparison of UUIDs as part of the logic that will later trigger metadata removal and addition without a space check.
Completes the memcmp; the result is used to decide on UUID tree operations that do not account for potential leaf overflow.
Condition leading to removal of old UUID; the removal happens but the later addition is not preceded by a space check, causing overflow.
Completes the condition; if true, the removal proceeds without ensuring the new addition will fit.
Removes the old UUID from the tree; this metadata update occurs before checking if the new UUID addition would overflow the leaf.
